notes: 🏆 Achievements: 29 badges for things that happen across all your stories, from becoming close with someone, keeping a promise, being there on someone's birthday and getting soaked in the rain, to 1,000 messages in one story. A little banner pops up when you unlock one; see them all in 🧰 Tools → 🏆 Achievements. The Tools tabs now wrap onto two rows on a computer so you can see them all.
